introHtml: Polyester oven mitts and pot holders offer a balance of heat resistance and durability for busy kitchens. Unlike cotton, polyester withstands repeated use without shrinking, making it ideal for bulk orders at restaurants, catering companies, or promotional giveaways. These mitts can be screen printed or embroidered with your logo, providing a professional look that holds up to frequent washing. Choose polyester for a cost-effective option that still protects hands from hot pans and baking sheets.
